title: 巨型章鱼风筝与河马的天然防晒霜
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol42/Vol42_晚读讲义_巨型章鱼风筝与河马的天然防晒霜_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol42_晚读讲义_巨型章鱼风筝与河马的天然防晒霜_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we have two surprises for you: a giant octopus that swims through the sky, and a river giant that makes its own sunscreen. Ready? Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天有两个惊喜等着你们：一只在天上游动的巨型章鱼，和一位会自己制造防晒霜的河里巨人。准备好了吗？出发！

blocks.en: First, let's look up at the sky. At a giant kite festival, thousands of kites fill the air. There are dragons and whales, sea turtles and astronauts, all floating high above the ground. But the biggest star of the show is an octopus — a giant octopus kite!
blocks.title: 巨型章鱼风筝
blocks.cn: 首先，让我们抬头看天。在巨型风筝节上，成千上万只风筝挤满了天空。有龙、有鲸鱼、有海龟，还有宇航员，全都高高地飘在地面上空。但全场最大的明星是一只章鱼——一只巨型章鱼风筝！

blocks.en: One famous octopus kite is eighty meters long. That is longer than two blue whales, nose to tail! It took its maker six months to finish. It is so big that a team of at least six people must work together to fly it. At minimum, six people hold the lines, and sometimes they even need a car to pull it into the air!
blocks.title: 巨型章鱼风筝
blocks.cn: 一只著名的章鱼风筝有八十米长，比两头蓝鲸首尾相连还要长！它的制作者花了六个月才完成。它太大了，必须由至少六个人组成的小组齐心协力才能放起来。最少也得六个人拉着线，有时候甚至需要一辆汽车把它拖上天！

blocks.en: When the wind catches it, the long arms wave and dance, and the whole sky turns into a colorful curtain. Visitors look up and yell with joy. In total, a big festival can fill the sky with thousands of kites, and people come from many countries just to watch. A small standard kite fits in your hand, but these giants need a whole team — and a lot of sky!
blocks.title: 巨型章鱼风筝
blocks.cn: 当风抓住它时，长长的手臂挥舞跳舞，整个天空变成了一幅彩色的幕布。游客们抬头望着，高兴地欢呼起来。总的来说，一场大型风筝节可以让成千上万只风筝挤满天空，人们从许多国家赶来，只为看上一眼。一只小小的标准风筝可以握在手里，但这些庞然大物需要一整个团队——还有一大片天空！

blocks.en: Now let's dive into the river and meet a very big animal with a very strange secret: the hippopotamus. When a hippo comes out of the water on a sunny day, its skin slowly turns pink. For a long time, people thought hippos sweated blood! Let me clarify: it is not blood, and it is not really sweat, either.
blocks.title: 河马的天然防晒霜
blocks.cn: 现在，让我们潜入河里，见一见一种身躯庞大、却藏着一个奇怪秘密的动物：河马。当河马在晴天从水里出来时，它的皮肤会慢慢变粉。很长一段时间里，人们都以为河马流的是血汗！让我澄清一下：那不是血，而且严格说来也不是汗。

blocks.en: Hippos do not have sweat glands like we do. Instead, tiny glands under their skin make a clear, oily fluid. In just a few minutes in the air and sun, the fluid turns pink and then red. Scientists found two special pigments inside it: a red one called hipposudoric acid, and an orange one called norhipposudoric acid.
blocks.title: 河马的天然防晒霜
blocks.cn: 河马没有像我们这样的汗腺。相反，它们皮肤下面微小的腺体会分泌一种清澈的油性液体。在空气和阳光下短短几分钟里，这种液体就会变粉、再变红。科学家在里面发现了两种特殊的色素：一种是红色的河马汗酸，另一种是橙色的去甲河马汗酸。

blocks.en: Together, they work like a natural sunscreen. They soak up the sun's ultraviolet rays, so the hippo's sensitive skin does not burn. The same fluid also fights bacteria, so small cuts from life in a muddy river do not easily get infected. And because it is oily, it keeps the skin soft and wet, like a built-in moisturizer.
blocks.title: 河马的天然防晒霜
blocks.cn: 它们一起，就像一种天然防晒霜。它们吸收太阳的紫外线，这样河马敏感的皮肤就不会被晒伤。同一种液体还能对抗细菌，所以在泥泞河里生活时受的小伤口不容易感染。而且因为它是油性的，它能让皮肤保持柔软湿润，就像自带的保湿霜。

blocks.en: Hippos spend most of the day in the water to stay cool. But when they come out onto the bank in the sun, their own pink sunscreen is already on the job. You have to appreciate how clever nature is!
blocks.title: 河马的天然防晒霜
blocks.cn: 河马一天中的大部分时间都待在水里，好保持凉爽。但当它们在阳光下走上河岸时，自己那粉色的防晒霜已经开始工作了。你不得不佩服大自然是多么聪明！

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'rain cats and dogs.' When it rains cats and dogs, it rains very, very heavily! Here's an example: 'We wanted to fly our kites at the festival, but it rained cats and dogs, so we waited under a big tent.' No cats or dogs really fall from the sky — it is just a fun way to say the rain is pouring down!
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“rain cats and dogs”（下猫下狗）。当 it rains cats and dogs 时，雨下得非常非常大！举个例子：“我们想在风筝节上放风筝，但当时雨下得像猫狗从天上掉下来一样，所以我们就在一个大帐篷下面等着。”其实并没有猫狗真的从天上掉下来——这只是说雨倾盆而下的一种有趣说法！

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories: a giant octopus kite that needs a whole team, and a hippo that makes its own sunscreen. First: if you could design any giant kite, what animal or shape would you pick? Second: the hippo's pink fluid does three jobs at once — can you think of another animal with a clever trick like that? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事：一只需要一整个团队才能放起来的巨型章鱼风筝，和一只会自己制造防晒霜的河马。第一：如果你能设计任意一只巨型风筝，你会选什么动物或形状？第二：河马的粉色液体一次能干三件活——你能想到还有哪种动物也有这样聪明的把戏吗？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Keep looking up, keep wondering, and may your next rainy day never rain cats and dogs — unless you love puddles! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。继续抬头看天，保持好奇，愿你下一个雨天永远不要下猫下狗——除非你喜欢水坑！明天见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:

A. Eight meters
B. Eighteen meters

D. It eats pink flowers

B. It rains very, very heavily

B. Two
C. Three

children.text: When a hippo comes out of the water on a sunny day, its skin slowly turns pink.
When a hippo comes out of the water on a sunny day
：When（当……的时候）+ 一整句话，放在句首交代整件事发生的时间——河马从水里出来的时候。英语里 when 从句可以前置，主句在后，中间用逗号隔开。
：slowly（慢慢地）放在动词 turns 前面，告诉你变化的速度——不是一下子变粉，而是慢慢变粉。副词修饰动词，说明动作是怎样发生的。
：turn（变成）+ 形容词 pink（粉色的），表示皮肤从原来的颜色变成了粉色。turn 后面跟形容词，不跟名词，这是“变色、变状态”的经典句型。
时间（河马出水时）→ 方式（慢慢地）→ 变化（皮肤变粉）
。一句话里藏着时间状语从句、副词和系表结构三个机关。
"One famous octopus kite is eighty meters long."
"Tiny glands under their skin make a clear, oily fluid. In just a few minutes in the air and sun, the fluid turns pink and then red."
"When it rains cats and dogs, it rains very, very heavily!"
. The fluid works as sunscreen, fights bacteria, and keeps the skin soft and wet — three jobs at once.
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
